title: Three days until GTA VI
caption: Three days. Here's what launch week actually means — and what we're doing about it. #GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6Countdown #ViceCity #gaming

segments.title: Three days until GTA VI
segments.vo: Three days. That is all that stands between us and Grand Theft Auto Six.

segments.title: September 2013 to November 2026
segments.vo: GTA Five came out in September twenty thirteen. That means most of us have waited more than thirteen years for a new main entry.

segments.title: Thursday, 19 November
segments.vo: And after two delays, Rockstar has confirmed the date. Thursday, the nineteenth of November, on PlayStation Five and Xbox Series X and S.

segments.title: What launch week usually looks like
segments.vo: Big launches tend to follow a pattern. The first day is pure exploration. Within a couple of days, players start finding the strange, funny and surprising details. That second wave is what we care about most, because it is where the best clips come from.

segments.title: Why the wait matters
segments.vo: Here is our honest take. A gap that long changes what people expect. Nobody is judging this game against other games. They are judging it against thirteen years of imagination. That is a very high bar, and it is exactly why the first week will be fascinating to watch.

segments.title: What we will do
segments.vo: So here is the plan. No leaks. No spoilers. Just real footage from launch, tested properly, with the surprising stuff first.

outro.title: Follow for launch week
outro.vo: Follow so you do not miss it.

title: Why Vice City is the right return
alt_hook: VICE CITY WAS ALWAYS THE ANSWER
caption: Vice City is back — and it's bigger than a city this time. Our take on why that matters. #GTA6 #ViceCity #Leonida #GTAVI #gaming

segments.title: Back to Vice City
segments.vo: GTA Six takes us back to Vice City. But this time it is part of something much bigger.

segments.title: The state of Leonida
segments.body: Vice City is one part of it
segments.vo: Rockstar has confirmed the game is set in Vice City and across the wider state of Leonida. So the city is a centrepiece, not the whole map.

segments.title: First seen in 2002
segments.vo: Vice City first became a full game setting back in two thousand and two. For a lot of players, it is the most iconic place the series has ever been.

segments.title: Why it works
segments.vo: Our opinion? It is the perfect choice for a comeback. Neon, beaches, money and chaos are a natural fit for a satirical crime story, and a whole state around the city gives room for very different places to explore.

segments.title: Three things we'll look at
segments.body: Street life · Night vs day · Getting around
segments.vo: So when we get in, we are looking at three things. How busy the streets feel. How different the city is at night compared to the day. And how it feels to travel from the city out into the rest of Leonida.

segments.title: First test
segments.vo: The first thing we want to see on launch day is simple. How does the city feel at street level, minute to minute? We will show you, unedited.

outro.title: Follow @yourviral7
outro.body: Vice City, tested on day one.

title: Lucia and Jason: what two leads could change
alt_hook: THIS CHANGES HOW YOU PLAY GTA
caption: Lucia and Jason. What we're watching for when we finally play as both. No spoilers. #GTA6 #Lucia #Jason #GTAVI #ViceCity

segments.title: Lucia Caminos & Jason Duval
segments.vo: GTA Six has two lead characters. Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval.

segments.title: Partners, not just a cast
segments.vo: From the official material, they are presented as a pair. So the big question is how much that partnership shows up in the moment to moment play, not just in the cutscenes.

segments.title: Who do you choose, and when?
segments.vo: The second question is control. When can you switch between them, and does it change how missions play out? Nobody outside Rockstar knows yet, and we are not going to pretend we do.

segments.title: Shared world, two points of view
segments.vo: And a third question. Does the world react differently depending on who you are playing? Small differences like that are exactly what we will be watching for, and we will only report what we can actually show you.

segments.title: What would make it great
segments.vo: Our take. Two leads works best when each one changes how you approach the same problem. If that happens here, it could be the biggest shift in how GTA feels in years.

segments.title: Our promise
segments.vo: When the game is out, we will test this properly, and we will never post story spoilers.

outro.title: Follow for day-one tests
outro.vo: Follow to see what we find.

title: Seven things we will test on launch day
caption: Our day-one test list. Which one do you want first? Comment the number. #GTA6 #GTAVI #GTA6Gameplay #gaming #ViceCity

segments.title: Seven things we will test
segments.vo: On the nineteenth of November, these are the seven things we are testing first. Pick your favourite.

segments.title: The questions everyone will ask
segments.vo: We picked these because they are the questions everyone asks in the first week. Not story questions. World questions. How the place actually behaves when you poke it.

segments.title: Crowds, traffic, weather
segments.body: 1. How busy the streets get  2. How traffic reacts  3. What weather changes
segments.vo: One. How alive the streets really feel. Two. How traffic reacts when things go wrong. Three. What changes when the weather does.

segments.title: Wanted level, water
segments.body: 4. How police respond  5. What you can do in the water
segments.vo: Four. How the police respond, step by step. Five. What you can actually do in and on the water.

segments.title: Distance and detail
segments.body: 6. Coast to city by car  7. The smallest details
segments.vo: Six. How long it takes to drive from the coast into the city. Seven. The tiny details nobody notices on the first day.

segments.title: Same test, filmed properly
segments.vo: Each test is simple. We set it up, we run it more than once, and we film the result. If something only happens once, we will say so, instead of pretending it always works.

segments.title: Real footage only
segments.vo: Every result will be real footage from our own game. No guesses, no fake clips, and no spoilers.

title: Rockstar's rules for posting GTA VI clips
hook: POSTING GTA VI CLIPS? READ THIS
alt_hook: DON'T GET YOUR CLIP TAKEN DOWN
caption: Before you post your first GTA VI clip — Rockstar's own fan policy, in 75 seconds. Save this. #GTA6 #GTAVI #gamingtips #ContentCreator #ViceCity

segments.title: Before you post GTA VI clips
segments.vo: Planning to post GTA Six clips? Rockstar has a published policy for fan videos, and almost nobody reads it. Here it is in plain English.

segments.title: No leaked pre-release footage
segments.vo: Rule one. No footage from before the official release. Rockstar says leaked footage gets taken down, however the copy was obtained, and that includes early unboxing videos.

segments.title: No isolated spoilers
segments.vo: Rule two. No spoilers. That means no endings, and no edits that string cutscenes together on their own. Cutscenes inside a larger playthrough are treated differently.

segments.title: No isolated in-game TV
segments.vo: Rule three. Do not post the in-game TV shows or comedy performances on their own. Rockstar wants people to see those inside the game.

segments.title: No cheats or exploits
segments.vo: Rule four. Nothing that promotes cheating, money glitches or mod menus in their online games.

segments.title: Safe-to-post checklist
segments.body: Your own copy · After release · No story reveals
segments.vo: In practice, that means filming from your own copy, posting only after the official release on the nineteenth of November, and keeping big story moments out of your clips.

segments.title: Non-commercial use
segments.vo: And the big one. The policy covers non-commercial use, and Rockstar can remove content at any time. Check the full policy on Rockstar's support site before you monetise anything.

outro.vo: Save this, and follow for launch week.
